title: Anthony Pappa - Selador Selected Works 2021 DJ Mix
blurb: Please enjoy this mix from the legendary Melbourne's own Anthony Pappa. As always it's a banging mix from him. This one's brought to you by the lads over at Selador Recordings — good old Dave Seaman, who's a great mate of Pappa's. Enjoy this one.

title: John Digweed - Live in London Recorded at fabric (CD3)
blurb: A quintessential John Digweed CD, recorded in London at the famous fabric. Disc three out of a four-disc mix — this is where it hits peak time, and really gives you a real feeling of what the great man's all about.
